description:
Description Amazon Live is building the future of shoppable video — connecting brands with customers through livestreams, short-form video, and creator-driven content across Amazon Shopping, Fire TV, Prime Video, and social platforms. The product serves millions of monthly viewers, processes billions of events daily across 9 marketplaces, and generates tens of millions of dollars in advertiser revenue, with a goal to reach 100MM+ MAUs and 20K+ brands in the next couple of years.

Amazon Live has a mature, high-performing data platform powering reporting across 9 marketplaces, 14+ dashboards, real-time creator analytics, and a growing suite of AI-native tooling (self-serve analytics agents, agentic operational assistants). The opportunity ahead is to build the next layer on that strong foundation: the team is standing up an intelligence layer — causal measurement, content intelligence, and ranking signals — and that requires a new class of foundational, reusable data assets purpose-built for both analytics and ML consumption. This role builds them.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the DESA team as a dedicated owner of forward-looking data architecture. You will design and build durable, well-modeled datasets that serve three consumers at once: the BIE for executive reporting, the Applied Scientists for model training, and downstream ML systems (ranking, personalization, recommendations) for feature consumption. The goal is leverage — build an asset once, serve many use cases, and let the whole team move faster on top of it. Your work becomes the foundation the science function builds on: when the data assets are ready ahead of need, scientists model from day one instead of waiting on bespoke pipelines.

This is a high-ownership role on a team that moves fast. You will go from problem to production quickly, in a challenging and fast-paced environment, and you will work across the full breadth of the data domain — platform engineering, data modeling, ML-ready feature production, data quality, and AI-assisted development. You will partner closely with Applied Scientists, MLEs, fellow Data Engineers, and the BIE, giving you the opportunity to learn and execute across every aspect of a modern data organization — from raw event ingestion through the models and reporting that move multi-million-dollar business decisions.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build a content metadata layer that unifies broadcast events, product catalog data, creator profiles, and show metadata into reusable assets consumed by both dashboards and models.
- Build cross-session shopper profile datasets that sessionize event data across visits and compute rolling engagement metrics (frequency, recency, depth, conversion lag).
- Build integration pipelines connecting retail catalog and advertising performance data into the Amazon Live platform, unlocking new dimensions for analytics and ML.
- Produce structured, ML-ready datasets that feed Applied Scientists' models and serve features to downstream ranking and personalization systems.
- Own and advance data quality: proactive monitoring and anomaly detection so the team stays ahead of issues.
- Advance platform engineering maturity — CI/CD for ETL (BDT/Maestro), standardized deployment, and AI-assisted code generation and review.
- Partner with Applied Scientists, MLEs, DEs, and the BIE to align data assets to model, serving, and reporting needs.

A day in the life
You will move fast across a broad surface. Some weeks you will be designing a denormalized content metadata asset with an Applied Scientist to unblock a new model; other weeks you will be integrating a retail or advertising data source, hardening a pipeline's CI/CD, building data-quality alarms, or packaging features for the distribution team's ranking systems. You will partner daily with scientists, MLEs, DEs, and the BIE — scoping what to build and how it will be consumed — and you will have self-serve analytics agents and agentic operational tooling to accelerate your work (and a hand in extending that tooling as the platform grows). The pace is quick, the problems span the full data lifecycle, and the ownership is real.

About the team
The DESA team owns the data platform, analytics, and sciences for Amazon Live and Shop the Show. It is a compact, senior, high-trust team: DEs own the infrastructure and foundational data assets, the BIE owns executive reporting, Applied Scientists and MLEs own the models, experiments, and signals that turn data into product value, and everyone collaborates closely across those boundaries. As a Data Engineer here, you own forward-looking data architecture — the durable, reusable foundation the intelligence layer is built on — and you get exposure to the entire data domain, from event ingestion through production ML and leadership reporting. Your datasets become shared org infrastructure: the inputs to attribution models for partner teams, ranking features for distribution, and the reporting the business runs on.

Shape Amazon's Future through Innovative Hiring Technology! Join Workforce Solutions and become a key player in Amazon's continued growth and innovation. As part of this dynamic organization, you'll be at the forefront of creating industry-leading interviewer experiences and developing robust, yet lightweight global recruiting solutions that are critical to Amazon's expansion and the launch of new products and services. In this role, you'll immerse yourself in every facet of the software development lifecycle, from initial design to final deployment and ongoing operations. Your contributions will be integral to crafting robust feature sets, intuitive designs, and user-friendly interfaces that empower Amazonians to excel in recruiting the world's top talent. We're seeking a self-driven professional with strong communication skills who can deliver high-quality results in our fast-paced environment.

Key job responsibilities
As a Data Engineer, you will/may:
• Design, implement, and automate deployment of our distributed system for collecting and processing log events from multiple sources.
• Design data schema and operate internal data warehouses and SQL/NoSQL database systems.
• Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, and dashboards that engineers, analysts, and data scientists use to drive key business decisions.
• Monitor and troubleshoot operational or data issues in the data pipelines.
• Drive architectural plans and implementation for future data storage, reporting, and analytic solutions.
• Develop code based automated data pipelines able to process millions of data points.
• Improve database and data warehouse performance by tuning inefficient queries.
• Work collaboratively with Business Analysts, Data Scientists, and other internal partners to identify opportunities/problems.
• Provide assistance with troubleshooting, researching the root cause, and thoroughly resolving defects in the event of a problem.

A day in the life
We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

About the team
Workforce Solutions (WS) empowers our customers by providing integrated, people-focused solutions that streamline hiring processes for WW Stores, AWS, Devices, and Talent Acquisition. As stewards of the employee lifecycle and experience, we drive initiatives that promote transparency and efficiency in career mobility, workforce engagement, and operational needs management. We prioritize customer-centricity by tailoring our capabilities and processes to align with their preferences and behaviors. Our approach is to start with the customer's needs and match individuals to the right opportunities through our services.

description:
Looking for your next challenge? North America Sort Centers (NASC) are experiencing explosive growth and looking for a skilled, highly motivated engineers to join the NASC SPEeD (Sortation Products Engineering and Data) team. The Sort Center network is the critical Middle-Mile solution in the Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) group, linking Fulfillment Centers to the Last Mile. The experience of our customers is dependent on our ability to efficiently execute volume flow through the middle-mile network. The SPEeD team is expected to build scalable solutions to address increasing operational complexity from the evolution of new processes such as containerization, heavy-bulky freight, international shipping, customer returns, and Amazon Robotics solutions. We need to continuously innovate on behalf of our customers and develop new platforms and new science-based planning tools to efficiently match processing supply to logistics demand.

Our mission is to build the most efficient and optimal sort center solution on the planet, using our technology and engineering as our biggest advantage. We aim to leverage cutting edge technologies in big data, machine learning, and optimization techniques, and operate high volume, low latency, and high availability services. Come and see for yourself why we are one of the most admired company in the US, rated #1 in Innovation and # 1 in Customer Service, and be part of our tradition of working hard, having fun and making history!

This is an entirely new initiative and great development opportunity which gives you the ability to come and shape our destiny! You will build new services and experiences and will work with new technologies that improve usability and increase performance and scalability. You will have an opportunity to work with a wide range of teams and services across Amazon. Also, you will have an opportunity to get guidance from principal product managers and senior engineers to help with your professional growth and development.

We prefer engineers who can thrive in a fast paced, high energy and fun work environment where we deliver value incrementally and frequently.


A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
- Maternity and Parental Leave Options
- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- 401(k) Plan  

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!
